propositions: Four AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT firings on 2026-08-12 missed DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX (1800s) by 10-130s with deferred_for values of 1810s, 1820s, 1810s, and 1930s, each interrupting an in-flight LLM-Review.
The 1800s bound was sized for steady-state review queue and is marginally too small during burst landing windows, firing at 10x normal rate during a 60+-merge burst.
DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX default is raised from 1800s (1.5x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) to 2400s (2.0x REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) to absorb observed overshoots.
The pinned test relationship in test_autodeploy_review_drain.py is tightened from >= 1.0x to >= 2.0x DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, enforced via DEFER_BOUND_REVIEW_CAP_MULTIPLE constant.
The raise absorbs the four 10-130s overshoots observed on Aug-12 but does not address saturated episodes where in_flight oscillates without reaching zero.
The bound remains anchored to a fixed multiple of the app's per-review cap so it self-adjusts when REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS changes, enforced by the tightened test.
